scope: Soundboard list, upload, play and received events bind to the connected voice server/channel, independently of the browsed server.
Backend checks current voice membership and rechecks the same joined session after repository I/O.
Playback and preview route to the selected output before starting, honor personal/master volume, block and deafen, and cancel on account/call/output changes.
Missing output devices alone allow default fallback; unsupported or denied custom routing reports failure.
Selected trim frames are encoded as the actual WAV upload; preview and upload reuse the same cached clip.
